## LayerResourceClient.get() method

Read the layer identified by `name`<!-- -->. When several layers share the same name, the first match in the app's order is used, and the operation does not fail as ambiguous.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get(name: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<Layer>;
```
